question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word to fill in the blank.**

Welter was an **__honest__ **worker, whereas Rodriguez was ______.
solution:
The correct answer is **"corrupt."**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Honest"** means (used about a person) telling the truth; not lying to people or stealing. ((व्‍यक्ति) सत्‍याचरण करने वाला, ईमानदार; चोरी आदि असत्‍याचरण न करने वाला)

 
 
• **Example**: *He is an **honest**__ man.*
 
 
 
• Antonym of **honest** is **corrupt**.
 
• **"Corrupt"** means doing or involving illegal or dishonest things in exchange for money, etc. (धन के बदले ग़ैर-कानूनी काम करना अथवा संलिप्त होना; भ्रष्‍ट)
 __
 
• **Example**: *He is a **corrupt**__ official.*
 
 
 
• The sentence is comparing Welter and Rodriguez on the basis of their work ethics.
 
• The correct answer is Option 3.

 

**Correct sentence**: *Welter was an honest worker, whereas Rodriguez was __**corrupt**__.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1 (erupt)** means to burst forth suddenly and violently. ((ज्‍वालामुखी का) फूट उठना या पड़ना (और आग, लावा आदि उगलना))
 
• **Option 2 (timid)** means lacking in courage or confidence. (जल्‍दी डर जाने वाला, भीरु; संकोची और जल्‍दी घबरा जाने वाला)
 
• **Option 4 (candid)** means truthful and straightforward. (स्‍पष्‍टवादी, तटस्‍थ, खरा)
